Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Fresh Food, Lovely Atmosphere, but Drinks Slightly Pricey
Jan 2026 • Couples
My full experience at Nori
FOOD
The highlight of the evening was the food. Everything was fresh, well-prepared and the clean flavors of the food made the meal enjoyable. The quality of the prepared ingredients stood out and the small bites and the more elaborate plates had a well-crafted satisfying balance and made the meal memorable.

DRINKS
The drink selection paired well with food and was decent, with a variety of cocktails and drinks. Although the drinks are enjoyable, the prices leaned on the higher side when compared to like venues. But, the quality was good and those who like well-crafted cocktails should enjoy what was offered.

ATMOSPHERE
The atmosphere was one of the strongest points of the restaurant. I particularly enjoyed the outdoor seating area. It has a laid-back and posh ambience that is ideal for relaxing with friends or for a low-key evening out. It is a breath of fresh air to combine modern design and outdoor dining. 

All in all, there is a lovely ambience and fresh, delicious cuisine at Nori - Modern Izakaya, while the drinks are good but slightly overpriced. It's a wonderful location to modern Japanese-inpired food in a relaxing atmosphere.
